x-errorMessage.pattern: '{property}' takes a resource location: a lowercase namespace and path joined by ':', such as "cobblemon:poke_ball", not {value}.
'{property}' takes an identifier: a lowercase path such as "poke_ball", optionally after a namespace and ':', as in "cobblemon:poke_ball", not {value}.
'{property}' takes a tag: '#' and then a lowercase identifier, such as "#minecraft:is_forest", not {value}.
